name: Stir-Fry Chicken
description: A savory stir-fry dish featuring chicken, vegetables, and a flavorful sauce, served with cheesy buns.
recipeIngredient: Mozzarella cheese and bacon bits for buns

recipeInstructions.text: Heat oil and garlic clove in a pan. Dip bun halves in hot oil, then place on a cookie sheet. Cover with mozzarella cheese and bacon bits. Broil 3 to 4 minutes.
Cube chicken breasts and brown in the pan. Add mushrooms, celery, onion, and Oriental vegetables. Cook thoroughly.
Make a well and add curry powder, soya sauce, Worcestershire sauce, Louisiana hot sauce, and Tabasco. Cook.
Add 1 cup water (or more as needed) to the vegetables. Mix cornstarch with water to thicken the sauce.
Serve the chicken and vegetable mixture over steamed rice with the cheesy buns.

_similar.name: Thai Chicken
_similar.description: A Thai-inspired chicken dish with spaghetti, vegetables, and a tangy sauce, served hot or chilled.
recipeIngredient: 2 tsp Sambal Oelek or hot pepper sauce

recipeInstructions.text: Cook pasta according to package directions for the minimum time. Drain, rinse with cold water, and drain again.
Stir pasta in a large bowl to coat with sesame oil.
Finely grate the peel from 1 lime and squeeze juice to measure 1/4 cup. Stir juice, peel, soya sauce, hot pepper sauce, salt, and sugar into pasta.
Slice chicken into bite-size pieces, thinly slice pepper, onion, and celery, and julienne carrots.
Stir-fry chicken in batches and return to the pan with garlic and onions. Stir-fry about 3 minutes.
Stir in water, peppers, celery, and carrots. Continue stirring about 3 minutes, adding a bit more water if necessary.
Add snow peas and stir about 1 minute.
Toss with the pasta, serve right away, or chill overnight and serve cold the next day.

_similar.name: Chicken-Pineapple Stir-Fry
_similar.description: A quick and flavorful stir-fry made with chicken breast, pineapple, and vegetables, served over hot rice.

recipeInstructions.text: Combine chopped onion, diced celery, green pepper strips, and pineapple chunks in a bowl.
In another bowl, mix together cornstarch, reserved pineapple juice, cinnamon, and soya sauce.
In a skillet over high heat, add margarine and cook chicken strips for 3 minutes, stirring frequently.
Add the onion mixture to the skillet and continue cooking for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the cornstarch mixture to the skillet, stir well, and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and cook until the sauce is clear and thickened.
Serve the stir-fry over hot rice.

_similar.keywords: chicken stir-fry, pineapple chicken, quick dinner

_similar.name: Easy Curried Chicken
recipeIngredient: Broccoli and carrots, cut into bite-size pieces

recipeInstructions.text: Grease the bottom of a pan and layer with vegetables.
Arrange chicken pieces on top of the vegetables.
Mix cream of chicken soup, mayonnaise, and curry powder.
Pour the soup mixture over the chicken.
Sprinkle bread crumbs on top.
Bake at 375°F for 1 hour.

_similar.keywords: curried chicken, creamy chicken, baked chicken casserole

_similar.name: Curry Chicken

recipeInstructions.text: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Mix all ingredients except chicken breasts in a microwave-safe bowl until butter is melted.
Arrange chicken breasts in a shallow baking dish sprayed with nonstick spray.
Pour the curry mixture over the chicken breasts.
Bake uncovered for 1 hour, stirring occasionally.
Serve over rice.

_similar.keywords: curry chicken, baked chicken, honey mustard chicken

_similar.name: Classy Chicken
_similar.description: A creamy, curry-flavored chicken dish with asparagus or broccoli and a cheddar cheese topping.
recipeIngredient: 1 (10 oz) pkg frozen asparagus or broccoli

recipeInstructions.text: Cut the chicken into 2×4 inch pieces and sprinkle with pepper.
Saute the chicken slowly in oil over medium heat until white and clear, about 6 minutes. Drain.
Cook asparagus or broccoli until tender crisp, drain, and arrange in the bottom of a buttered 7-inch diameter casserole dish.
Place the cooked chicken on top of the asparagus or broccoli layer.
Mix the cream of chicken soup, mayonnaise, curry powder, and lemon juice together and pour over the chicken.
Sprinkle the grated cheddar cheese over the top.
Bake, uncovered, at 375 °F for 30 to 35 minutes.

_similar.keywords: creamy chicken, curry chicken, asparagus, cheddar cheese
